title: Pomona Sensor Event
description: Sensor packet accepted by pomona-core HTTP and MQTT ingestion (services/core/app/schemas.py SensorEvent; services/core/tests/test_sensor_event_schema.py keeps the two in line). A probe that did not report is absent or null; a packet needs at least one non-null reading (anyOf). crop, growth_stage and system_type are optional: Core fills the defaults shown. Unknown properties are ignored by Core, so they are allowed here. Not expressible in JSON Schema and checked by Core only: a timestamp before MIN_SAMPLE_TIME (default 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z) or more than MAX_FUTURE_SAMPLE_S (default 300 s) ahead of Core's clock is rejected, and NaN or Infinity are refused.

weather.description: Optional daily weather aggregates for the FAO-56 ET calculation; not a reading.

zone_area_m2.description: Optional zone context for the model-router's FAO-56/NPK calculator; not a reading.

crop_kc.description: Optional crop coefficient for the ET calculation; not a reading.

npk_target.description: Optional target nutrient concentration for fertigation dosing; not a reading.

timestamp.description: Sample time, required and timezone-aware (a trailing Z or an offset such as +04:00); Core never invents one.

received_at.description: Set by Core on receipt; a value sent by the device is ignored.

sequence.description: Per-boot packet counter, used with boot_id to drop duplicates and stale packets.

mqtt_retained.description: Set by the transport (the MQTT retain flag); a value sent by the device is ignored.

schema_version.description: Payload contract version MAJOR.MINOR; omitted means 1.0. Core rejects other majors.
